thread:
jamie: Heads up — external pentest scheduled next Wed. Need RBAC lock-down, KMS access model, and a reproducible evidence export for triage + retest. Who owns access plan and evidence format?

maria: I can own access plan. Confirm scope = staging + subset of prod auth logs (no PII). Also need ephemeral creds timeline.

dan: Scope sounds right. Recommend scoped service roles not user grants. Example minimal IAM policy for assessor role: { "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-logs/*"] }

luis: Use envelope encryption — export logs encrypted to evidence-vault using PT KMS key. Assessor gets temp role to read that bucket. Include SHA256 checksums for artifacts. Packaging example: aws s3 cp ... && shasum -a 256 pt-session.tgz > pt-session.tgz.sha256 && aws s3 cp pt-session.tgz s3://redwood-evidence-vault/PT-4523/

olivia: Retest window note — we promised client retest starting 2 weeks after fixes. Proposed cadence: initial test Wed, draft report Fri, fixes sprint, retest window in two weeks.

jamie: Owners: maria=access playbook + ephemeral roles, dan=IAM policies, luis=evidence packaging + manifest, olivia=stakeholder comms & retest cadence. Filed ticket PT-4523. Add blockers there.

dan: On audit logging — export CloudTrail and app auth logs to evidence-vault with object tags (pt=4523, assessor=acme). Retention for exported objects = 90 days; lifecycle to Glacier after 30 days.

maria: Ephemeral creds via STS, max 4h. Will write playbook for on-call to mint read-room creds. Quick validation: kubectl auth can-i ... --as=assessor-role

deploy-bot: role-grant: created arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-4523-assessor-role (expires in 4h) — verify access and report missing perms.

luis: Verified read access to evidence bucket with role. Will include metadata manifest JSON with file paths + sha256 + export_ts and pointer to audit log.

jamie: Next steps: maria publish playbook EOD, dan push IAM to staging by tomorrow noon, luis run end-to-end export into PT-4523, olivia confirm retest slot. Sync standup 11am tomorrow to sign off. :thumbsup:
